description: The Comp Desk's catalog of New York workers' compensation formulas (AWW, rates and bounds, SLU, LWEC, Section 32, Burns, attorney fee): the formula, what each symbol means, a plain explanation, the statutory citation, and a flag saying whether that citation has been attorney-reviewed. Pass id for one formula, query to search, or nothing for the list.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "reduced earnings".

name: lookup_formula
title: NY WC formula and citation
